jobs.title: AVP, Customer Success - Enterprise and Strategic Accounts
jobs.description:
**Who we are:**

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

### **About the Role:**

Motive is seeking an accomplished customer success executive to serve as AVP, Customer Success — Enterprise & Strategic Accounts. This leader will own the strategy, operating rhythm, and performance of customer success for Motive’s largest and most complex customers in North America.

The AVP will lead a high-performing organization responsible for driving measurable customer outcomes, product adoption, retention, and expansion. This person will build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders, create a predictable and data-driven customer success model, and partner closely with Sales, Product, Support, Professional Services, Operations, Finance, and Marketing.

This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role for an operator who can set direction, raise standards, simplify execution, and personally engage when the customer relationship or business outcome demands executive leadership.

### **What You'll Do:**

* Set the vision and strategy for enterprise and strategic customer success, aligned to Motive’s company priorities and customers’ most important business outcomes.
* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing customer success organization with clear expectations, strong accountability, and a culture of customer advocacy.
* Own the operating model for customer health, executive sponsorship, success planning, risk management, renewals, and expansion in partnership with Sales and account leadership.
* Establish rigorous mechanisms to improve gross revenue retention, net revenue retention, logo retention, product adoption, and time-to-value.
* Build a consistent, data-informed view of customer health, including leading indicators, renewal risk, adoption gaps, escalation patterns, and expansion opportunities.
* Create executive engagement programs that deepen relationships with customer decision-makers and establish Motive as a strategic partner.
* Partner with Sales leadership to improve account planning, renewal readiness, commercial alignment, and the transition from implementation to ongoing value realization.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to translate enterprise customer feedback into clear, prioritized product insights and roadmap influence.
* Work cross-functionally with Support, Professional Services, Operations, and other teams to resolve systemic issues and improve the end-to-end customer experience.
* Develop scalable playbooks for onboarding, adoption, executive business reviews, risk mitigation, renewal management, and expansion.
* Personally lead high-impact customer escalations and strategic account interventions, bringing urgency, sound judgment, and a long-term perspective.
* Define and communicate the team’s goals, metrics, forecasts, and performance trends to executive leadership.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, remove friction, and increase the effectiveness of the customer success organization.

### **What We're Looking For:**

* 12+ years of experience in customer success, account management, professional services, or a related customer-facing function, including 5+ years leading senior customer success organizations.
* Experience leading customer success for enterprise and strategic accounts in a complex B2B technology, SaaS, platform, or hardware-enabled software environment.
* Demonstrated ownership of business outcomes such as gross revenue retention, net revenue retention, renewals, expansion, adoption, and customer lifetime value.
* Experience leading organizations through scale, transformation, or increased operating rigor.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to build credibility with customer executives and internal leaders.
* A track record of developing leaders, setting a high bar for performance, and building inclusive, accountable teams.
* Strong analytical and operational discipline, with the ability to turn customer and business data into clear priorities and action.
* Exceptional cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to influence without relying solely on formal authority.
* A practical, customer-first leadership style with the judgment to balance strategic thinking and hands-on execution.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

### **Preferred experience:**

* Experience supporting customers with complex operational, logistics, transportation, field-service, or other physical-world workflows.
* Experience leading customer success in a business that combines hardware, software, and services.
* Experience building or modernizing customer health scoring, renewal forecasting, executive sponsorship, or scaled success programs.
* Experience operating in a high-growth, customer-centric technology company.

jobs.title: Child Development Assistant
jobs.description:
Kung Fu Kids Newark is hiring! We are in search of a full-time team member who wants to make a positive impact on the lives of children.

No experience necessary! If you've never learned martial arts, that's OK! We will teach you the skills and our teaching methodology to turn you into an amazing kids' instructor.

**To succeed you will need to be:**

* Willing to Learn. Come with an open mind, ready to be pushed to excel!
* Physically fit. This is an active job teaching martial arts to children!
* Engaging and enthusiastic. Part of being great with kids is being fun to be around!

**This is What It's Like to Work Here:**

Each day begins with 1-hour of Team Development where we learn and rehearse the lesson plans for the day. Your supervisor trains you in childhood development, teaching methodology, and the technical skills you need.

Then, it's time to lead! You'll teach five different programs:

* Grasshoppers (2-3 yr olds) - Develop social and physical skills for our youngest students in this parent-participation class.
* Little Pandas (4-6 yr olds) - Help these young curious minds develop a love for movement while gaining focus, discipline, and confidence through a fun and structured class.
* Mighty Tigers (7-9 yr olds) - Inspire confidence and resilience in these energetic learners by building fundamentals. At this age, kids are developing their sense of independence, so we focus on discipline, perseverance, and positive habits while keeping the classes dynamic and fun.
* Rising Dragons (10-14 yr olds) - Turn these children into successful adults by teaching them life skills which will benefit them forever! Martial arts is the best vehicle to teach them a positive mindset.
* Spectrum Stars (special needs) - Teach children who need a caring instructor with lots of patience and understanding. We adapt our martial arts program to meet each child where they are.

Throughout the day, you'll also meet trial students and sell memberships. After classes are done for the day, you'll help reset and tidy up the studio, and then close up for the day. Well done!

**Requirements:**

* You must be capable of thriving in a highly disciplined and structured environment.
* You must be driven to learn and grow constantly, living outside your comfort zone.
* You must be extremely reliable and committed to always being on time.
* You must be an excellent communicator.
* You must be in great physical condition.

* Sun 11:30 am - 4:15 pm

* Criminal background check.
* Reference checks.

**Benefits:**

* $23-$34/hour, raises based on improvement.
* Kaiser Permanente Health Insurance
* Deltacare Dental HMO
* Optional Vision Care
* Paid sick leave.
* No working on most major holidays.
* A supportive CEO who encourages growth and supports his team.

**Serious about this opportunity? Text a selfie video to 408-707-0406 introducing yourself and why you want to join our team.**

jobs.description:
Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team.

  

### **Front of House Attendant | The Mallory, NYC**

**Reports To:** Event Services Manager

**Schedule:** Full Time. Flexible availability required for varying event calendar.

**Hourly Rate:** $21 per hour with overtime eligibility

  

**About The Mallory:**

The Mallory is Convene Hospitality Group's premier new event destination located within the historic Terminal Warehouse in West Chelsea, New York. Reimagined from a landmark 19th-century freight hub into a dynamic 50,000-square-foot venue, The Mallory blends original industrial architecture with modern design and technology to host everything from galas and fashion shows to weddings and private celebrations for up to 550 guests. We are building a hospitality-oriented team dedicated to delivering thoughtful, high-touch experiences for every client and guest who step through our doors. Learn more about our space at: https://www.themallorynyc.com.

As we continue building our opening team, we are seeking full-time Front of House Attendants to support the seamless execution of events from setup through completion. In this role, you will transform and maintain event spaces to meet each client's unique vision, ensuring guest-facing areas remain polished, organized, and event-ready throughout the day. You will provide real-time support by adjusting room layouts, replenishing supplies, coordinating deliveries, assisting with food and beverage service, and managing inventory and event equipment. Working behind the scenes, you will also safely move and stage furniture, tables, seating, and other event assets while helping maintain an organized back-of-house environment and upholding safety standards to deliver exceptional experiences for every guest.

  

**Overview:**

As a Front of House Attendant at The Mallory, you are essential to the venue's physical transformation and its constant readiness for the next event. This role is designed for a detail-oriented individual who takes pride in navigating a versatile, ever-changing floor plan and ensuring the seamless execution of unique, high-profile moments. You work throughout the venue to ensure every layout and detail is perfect for our guests, providing the behind-the-scenes support that makes every event successful.

#### **Event Experience**

* Transform event spaces by precisely placing furniture, equipment, and décor to match the specific vision for each unique gathering.
* Act as a quick-response resource for event staff or clients, making real-time adjustments to room layouts or restocking supplies as needs evolve.
* Monitor the space throughout the day to ensure all guest-facing areas remain immaculate and gallery-ready for an exceptional experience.
* Setup and serve food & beverage offerings as required throughout the venue, including those provided by external food & beverage partners and vendors.

#### **Venue Operations**

* Coordinate the arrival and organization of vendor, client, and internal deliveries while maintaining clear communication with the operations team.
* Support the beverage and inventory programs by managing the flow of glassware, linens, and supplies needed for high-quality service.
* Carry out regular inventory counts and organize equipment storage to keep back-of-house areas organized and ready for the next event transition.

#### **Event Readiness & Safety**

* Execute the movement and positioning of event assets including tables, staging, and seating with a focus on efficiency and proper lifting techniques.
* Maintain the condition of the venue by handling high-end furniture and equipment with care, ensuring everything is staged safely and stays in peak form.
* Prioritize a secure environment by keeping load-in paths clear, utilizing correct transport tools, and following safety protocols during active room transitions.

jobs.title: Customer Success & Supply Chain Associate
jobs.description:
**About VR Expert**

VR Expert is a fast-growing international virtual reality and augmented reality business-to-businees reseller, with offices in New York, the Netherlands, Germany and France. We partner with businesses across industries to help them integrate cutting-edge VR/AR technology into how they work — from education, healthcare to robotics and beyond. We serve companies such as Tesla, Walmart, Amazon, Ford and Airbus.

We are currently building our US market presence from the ground up, which means the people who join us now have a rare opportunity to shape the company from the start.

**What the Job Looks Like Day to Day**

VR Expert is a diverse company consisting of ambitious people from different backgrounds. The average company age is below 30 and the atmosphere is informal but our ambitions are big.

You'll join our Customer Success team, responsible for onboarding clients to our VR products & packages, Installation guides, & purchasing channels. The role entails some cross-team collaboration, working closely with the Operations and the Sales teams.

When a new customer joins us, you'll help them get started: explaining how their order is packaged, writing simple installation instructions, and showing them how to order through purchase orders or our dashboard. You'll sit in on onboarding calls with our sales team to see how it's done. Day to day, you'll keep orders moving by resolving anything that's missing or on hold, creating purchase orders, and checking in with suppliers so nothing slips through the cracks. Over time the role becomes more client-facing, with you joining calls alongside the sales team to solve problems and build relationships with both customers and suppliers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Completion of customer onboarding tasks
* Installation instruction drafting
* Customer communication
* Customer ordering dashboard creation
* Day to day stock purchasing
* Purchase order / Supplier chase up
* On hold tracking and release communications

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree (fresh graduates are very welcome)
* Fluent English, written and spoken
* US work authorization
* Based in or able to commute to Brooklyn, NY

You might be a recent graduate or early in your career, and that's perfectly fine. Previous experience in this field is a plus, but it's not what we're hiring for. We care more about how you work than what's on your CV. You're motivated and proactive, the kind of person who spots a problem and starts fixing it before anyone asks. You have a sharp eye for detail, because in this role a missing item or a wrong quantity matters. You like bringing order to messy processes, whether that's a spreadsheet, a checklist, or a way of tracking orders. You have a natural curiosity for technology, and are excited to learn more about VR.

**What we offer**

* Salary: $55 - $60k annual salary.
* Time Off: 20 days PTO.
* Atmosphere and culture: Working in an international and dynamic team in a tech start-up. Enjoy cozy team outings and drinks to strengthen bonds with your colleagues.
* Development: professional development by learning hands-on skills from our Head of Operations and significant opportunity to grow within the company.
* Additional Benefits: Full travel and commuting reimbursement & annual training budget.

Interested in getting to know us over a cup of coffee?

Contact us!

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $55,000.00 - $60,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

This is a great opportunity for a college student, recent graduate, or early-career professional interested in **business operations, finance, data, inventory, healthcare management, or process improvement.**

This is not a traditional receptionist position. We are looking for someone who enjoys organizing information, working with numbers and spreadsheets, researching problems, and finding better ways to get things done.

What You'll Work On

Projects may include:

* Creating spreadsheets, trackers, reports, and business summaries
* Organizing and analyzing operational and financial information
* Comparing vendor pricing, expenses, subscriptions, and purchasing options
* Assisting with inventory and cost-control projects
* Tracking recruiting, onboarding, training, and employee information
* Organizing policies, documents, and shared files
* Researching software, vendors, equipment, and business services
* Helping implement new systems and processes
* Supporting marketing and other business-development projects
* Following assigned projects from research through completion

Your role will often be to **collect information, organize it clearly, compare options, and prepare it for management review.** Final financial, staffing, and business decisions remain with management.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

* Highly organized and detail-oriented
* Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets
* Good with numbers and data
* Curious and willing to research and solve problems
* Able to work independently
* Reliable and able to follow through
* Comfortable learning new software and systems
* Able to handle confidential business information

Previous veterinary experience is **not required**.

This position may be especially interesting for students or graduates studying **business, finance, accounting, business analytics, operations, supply chain, healthcare administration, economics, marketing, or entrepreneurship.**

What You'll Gain

You will work directly with hospital leadership and gain hands-on experience in areas such as business operations, financial analysis, inventory, vendor management, data reporting, recruiting, process improvement, software implementation, and healthcare administration.

We especially value people who see a messy process and think:

**"There has to be a better way to organize this."**

**Location:** Bronx, NY  
**Schedule:** Part-Time or Full-Time; flexibility around a school schedule may be available  
**Compensation:** $18–$22/hour, depending on experience and skills

Job Types: Full-time, Part-time

Pay: $18.00 - $22.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

**About Pose Aesthetics**

Pose Aesthetics is a medical aesthetics clinic dedicated to providing high-quality treatments and exceptional patient experiences.

We are looking for a confident, professional and motivated **Receptionist & Sales Coordinator** to join our Wolverhampton clinic.

As the first point of contact for our patients, you will play a vital role in creating an outstanding experience from the moment they arrival at the clinic and beyond.

This is a varied, hands-on position combining front-of-house reception, patient care, administration and sales. We are looking for someone who enjoys building relationships and takes pride in delivering exceptional customer service.

**Sales will be a key part of this role.** You will be responsible for responding to enquiries, following up with potential patients, converting leads into bookings, promoting clinic memberships and skincare products, and helping maximise clinic revenue.

The successful candidate will confident communicating with customers and motivated by achieving results. You should be comfortable discussing our treatments, services, pricing and offers while delivering a professional and welcoming patient experience.

**This position also offers commission on membership sign-ups and skincare product sales, providing the opportunity to earn additional income alongside your basic hourly pay.**

If you are passionate about customer service, confident in sales and eager to contribute to the growth of a busy aesthetics clinic, we would love to hear from you.

Preferred experience in Beauty/Aesthetics/Dental Clinic
